138030.title: The Coward
138030.overview: Amitabha Roy is a Calcutta-based scriptwriter, driving around in the country to collect material for a film. His vehicle breaks down in a small town. A tea planter, Bimal Gupta, offers hospitality for the night. Amitabha is forced to accept the offer as he has no alternative.

153518.title: The Angry Birds Movie
153518.overview: An island populated entirely by happy, flightless birds or almost entirely. In this paradise, Red, a bird with a temper problem, speedy Chuck, and the volatile Bomb have always been outsiders. But when the island is visited by mysterious green piggies, it’s up to these unlikely outcasts to figure out what the pigs are up to.

200174.title: Nevermore, Forever
200174.overview: Claire returns to France following the death of her actress friend Agathe. She attends an auction of her friend's possessions, provoking memories of the past.

620782.title: Tribute to the Teachers
620782.overview: A documentary featuring interviews with teachers and officials on the profession of teaching and what it means to them.

701486.title: Piccola arena Casartelli
701486.overview: A portrait, collected and discharged, of a small family-run circus that moves from one nucleus to another in the Bolognese lowlands, with its present nomad and its tragic past.

822830.title: The Ghosts
822830.overview: a group has been hired for a mission to rescue a hostage in a way far farm at country road

947502.title: In Waves
947502.overview: In Los Angeles, AJ, a shy teenager, meets Kristen. She lives for surfing; he loves skateboarding and drawing. They fall madly in love, and a happy future seems within reach. But everything changes when Kristen faces a sudden illness. Together, they face adversity, driven by the strength of their love, their friends, and their newly shared passion for surfing and the ocean.

1000174.title: My Tiny Little School
1000174.overview: With Ma toute petite école, Pascal Plisson follows, over the course of a year, the school life of the eight children living in the tiny hamlet of La Gurraz, in the Haute Tarentaise region. At the heart of this village of just 36 inhabitants, their school, threatened with closure, represents far more than a place of learning: it is the soul of an isolated community, where every birth and every pupil helps keep the village alive.

1056494.title: Narciso
1056494.overview: Paraguay, 1958. The charismatic Narciso returns from Buenos Aires with rock ’n’ roll in his veins. Under the suffocating military regime, his radio show becomes a music sensation and a symbol of freedom.

1078446.title: Violent Night 2
1078446.overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

1122030.title: Alpha
1122030.overview: When Sita, a highly trained assassin raised in isolation as a super-soldier by a rogue commander, discovers the dark truth about her family and her stolen childhood, she teams up with her long lost sister to take down her creator and his illicit military program.

1124142.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
1124142.overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

1142510.title: Sinless
1142510.trailerName: A pokol élővilága (16) - előzetes I Mozinet

1149614.title: Yes
1149614.overview: In the days following October 7, Y., a jazz musician, and his wife Yasmin, a dancer, resolve to say yes to everything. Y. and Yasmin sell their bodies and souls to the highest bidder, surrendering themselves and their art to Israel’s social, political and military elite. Soon, Y. is entrusted with a mission of the utmost importance: to compose the music for a rousing, ruthless new national anthem.

1247662.title: Villeneuve: The Rise of a Legend
1247662.overview: Showcases the early years of Québec racing driver Gilles Villeneuve.
1247662.trailerName: VILLENEUVE : L'ASCENSION D'UNE LÉGENDE | Bande-annonce officielle

1251630.title: Blanket Wearer
1251630.overview: The protagonist sets out to find ways to survive without money. She lives in squats, feeds herself by skip-diving and works in organic farms. Leaving the UK, she hitchhikes across Europe. Travelling with hippies, she reconnects with nature and opens herself to go with the flow to find peace. She continues her journey toward the East and becomes closer to her true home.

1263022.title: Get Lite
1263022.overview: Saunders, a headstrong Bronx teenager, is caught between his love of Litefeet subway dancing and his strict's insistence on becoming an engineer.

1293550.title: Bandar
1293550.overview: TV star Samar's life spirals when his ex Gayatri accuses him of rape after he blocks contact with her. Despite his new relationship with Khushi, he faces arrest and encounters a corrupt justice system.
1293550.trailerName: BANDAR | Official Trailer | Bobby D, Sanya M, Sapna P, Saba A | Nikhil D, Anurag K | In Cinemas Jun5

1307118.title: Soulm8te
1307118.overview: After a ruthless tech giant acquires a small robotics company, a grieving engineer is tasked with testing their new AI companion. But when he attempts to reprogram her to be a truly sentient soulmate, she develops needs of her own—unleashing a relentless spree of precision-engineered mayhem.

1308910.title: In the Land of Arto
1308910.overview: Céline arrives in Armenia for the first time to legalize the death of Arto, her husband. She discovers that he has lied to her, that he fought in the war, usurped his identity, and that his former friends consider him a deserter.
1308910.trailerName: BIFF2025 Trailer | In the Land of Arto | A Window on Asian Cinema

1316398.title: Our Erika
1316398.overview: The inspiring journey of Estonian track bicycle racer Erika Salumäe, as she navigates the pressures of fame, personal sacrifice, and national pride, redefining resilience in the pursuit of her Olympic dreams.
1316398.trailerName: MEIE ERIKA - Karolin Jürise on Erika Salumäe | Kinodes 13. veebruarist | Treiler | Meie Erika

1325614.title: Badland Rising
1325614.overview: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

1340206.title: Tuner
1340206.overview: A gifted piano tuner's meticulous skills for tuning pianos lead him to discover an unexpected aptitude for cracking safes, turning his life upside down.
1340206.trailerName: TUNER Trailer 4K (2026) | Leo Woodall, Havana Rose Liu, Dustin Hoffman, Jean Reno | Crime, Thriller

1341422.title: The Eyes of Others
1341422.overview: In the untamed beauty of the island owned by an extraordinarily wealthy Marquis, Elena's arrival marks the beginning of a passionate love affair. Complicity and transgression, sex and power, in a film inspired by 1960s Italian true crime, where erotic play unfolds into obsession.

1361774.title: The Dink
1361774.overview: Desperate to save a struggling country club and earn his father's respect, a washed-up tennis pro is compelled to break a sacred vow and do the unthinkable: play pickleball.

1364206.title: Street Fighter 8 (Finish Him)
1364206.overview: The final chapter. Balthasar turned all wimen on earth in to Merle and starts his conquest to rule the whole world. Nick and Luca the two only survivors of the deadly conflict angainst Balthasar, are trying to build a team that could stop the purple gigant from dominating the mordern world. Balthasar and the Boys are are pitted against each other in an epic battle that will determine the fate of Merle, Balthasar, the Boys and the future for even human beeing on earth.

1390382.title: Couture
1390382.overview: An American filmmaker faces challenges and self-discovery as she arrives in Paris for Fashion Week on a life-and-death journey.

1393326.title: Ghost in the Cell
1393326.overview: In a notorious prison, an invisible force begins killing inmates brutally, compelling enemy gangs and corrupt guards to work together as they try to survive the mounting bloodshed.

1394926.title: Watchful Eyes
1394926.overview: Sebastian, a grieving man, takes a janitor job on a university campus. While monitoring students linked to a professor’s death, he uncovers a ghost story that may be more real than anyone believed.

1407278.title: The Serpent's Skin
1407278.overview: Two young women form a romantic bond after discovering they have supernatural powers. Their insecurities unknowingly release a demon, which possesses one of their exes and begins feeding on their friends. As the bodies pile up, it becomes up to the women to face their pasts and stop the growing evil.
1407278.trailerName: The Serpent's Skin (2026) | Official Red Band Trailer

1427822.title: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
1427822.overview: A police officer being investigated for his role in a woman’s death rushes to save his son from her vengeful father.

flatrate.name: AP International South Cinema Amazon Channel

1438958.title: Antartica - Quasi una fiaba
1438958.overview: A small group of scientists, unreachable for eight months, explores the future of humanity. Maria Medri, a foreign genius, arrives in Antarctica, challenging Fulvio Cadorna's plans. They are similar but conflicting, as everyone desires their own. This scientific, ideological, and emotional conflict unfolds.

1443374.title: All the Good Eyes
1443374.overview: The story chronicles four decades in the lives of a family deeply rooted in the soil of Northeast China. Through times of prosperity and hardship, they navigate cycles of love and hatred, fortune and misfortune. Though buffeted by the twists of fate, they never relinquish their steadfast guardianship of one another and the profound commitment to this ancestral land that sustains them.
1443374.trailerName: 电影 《森中有林》 定档预告: 于和伟, 高圆圆, 韩庚, 张天爱 主演

1444590.title: The Great Skull
1444590.overview: Gu Liyan, on the verge of graduating from university, suddenly faced her father's death and had to assist her sharp-witted mother in navigating the tedious funeral arrangements. Unexpectedly, the 'Funeral Affairs Committee' secretly organized by her father before his death suddenly arrived at their doorstep... With unanticipated guests, absurd situations, and ridiculously dramatic events, the mother-daughter duo urgently needed to gather their strength to confront it all.

1453422.title: Lucky Lu
1453422.overview: A delivery driver in New York City discovers his e-bike has been stolen. With his family en route after many years apart, Lu must contend with a community that has turned its back on him while he tries to replace the only thing promising to keep his family afloat.

1461870.title: Motherwitch
1461870.overview: Cyprus, 1882: Eleni, an outcast painter, tries to resurrect her dead children but instead unleashes mythical creatures upon her village. Only by becoming a good mother to a talented, but abused child can she reverse the curse.

1466670.title: Think Good
1466670.overview: When Gil meets Jacques, their love seems irresistible. And when she unexpectedly falls pregnant, he convinces her to start a family. However, their hasty marriage reveals that she is not as deeply rooted into the Jewish faith as he is. Jacques reassures her: "Think good and it will be good". Little by little, Gil realizes the insidious control he exerts over her life...

1468846.title: Species
1468846.overview: Margot, a young intern at the country's most competitive ER, struggles in the high-pressure environment. When multiple patients her age arrive with strange symptoms, her own body begins experiencing alarming transformations.

1475374.title: Twisted Retreat
1475374.overview: Four friends on a weekend retreat unravel secrets, sparking tension and betrayal. A game of Truth or Dare turns sinister as an unseen killer stalks them. Paranoia rises, trust shatters, and one by one, they fall—until a shocking truth changes everything.

1491758.title: A Royal Romance in Ibiza
1491758.overview: After a painful breakup with her ex-business partner, Dylan Harper, a talented American developer, is determined to prove herself on her next big contract - creating a luxury wellness hotel for His Royal Highness King Edward on the breathtaking island of Ibiza. The opportunity is a dream come true for Dylan - until she comes face to face with the king's son, Prince Nicholas, a dashing bachelor with his own ideas on how to execute the hotel project.
1491758.trailerName: A Royal Romance In Ibiza | Nicely Entertainment | Trailer

ads.name: Amazon Prime Video Free with Ads

1512942.title: Love Battle
1512942.overview: After a breakup, Tan Jie clashes with love-idealist Ji Xiaode at work. As rivals turn allies, two wounded hearts must decide: dare to love again?

1518062.title: The Grandmaster's Gift
1518062.overview: In the late 1990s, young Yixuan grows up as a “latchkey kid” in Wanhua, Taipei. With his father busy driving a taxi, Yixuan spends lonely afternoons wandering local diners and Youth Park. In the park, he meets Liu Bin, a lonely chess master. Yixuan finds guidance and warmth in his new teacher, who challenges him to daily matches with a small wager. This bond bridges generations, revealing how love can emerge in unexpected places and how life, much like chess, unfolds in unpredictable ways.

1530606.title: The Penthouse
1530606.overview: "The Penthouse" is a psychological thriller that follows Saina and David, a young family who moves into a luxurious penthouse in Kuala Lumpur to start a new life.

1535470.title: Ask E. Jean
1535470.overview: The thrilling story of E. Jean Carroll’s life, from her early days as Miss Cheerleader USA to her rise as a trailblazing journalist, author, and beloved advice columnist. Carroll broke barriers as the first female editor at Esquire, Playboy, and Outside, helping to redefine women’s roles in media with her sharp wit and fearless voice. In recent years, she reignited public discourse by standing up to power, becoming the only woman to beat Donald Trump twice in court, and sparking a national conversation about truth, accountability, and resilience. A portrait of an indomitable woman who proved it’s never too late to reclaim your voice, rewrite your story, and change the world.

1537518.title: The Cycle of Love
1537518.overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

1538030.title: Infernal
1538030.overview: Infernal follows Azrael, a young man bound to forces beyond his control as rival powers close in around him. His journey in search of his wife tests his loyalty and betrayal ignites a struggle that will decide the world’s fate.

1545966.title: Forest
1545966.overview: Two Muscovites go on a trip to Karelia and disappear without a trace in an endless, dense forest. Each attempt to get out turns into a new threat. The forest seems to breathe, watch and does not want to let go... It becomes clear: the Forest lives by its own rules, which there is no time to understand - without food and water, the girls will not last long. In the meantime, one strange family moves into an abandoned village house. Strangers are not welcome here. After all, they used to live in the Forest.

1550062.title: Please Comment On It
1550062.overview: Katya and Ivan are on the verge of divorce. They agree to participate in an unusual family therapy: a Commentator will live with them for a month - a person who speaks out all their thoughts and feelings.

1559982.title: Give Me Some Sugah
1559982.overview: A Chicago bakery owner is stunned by a miraculous discovery that challenges her to reclaim lost time, heal old wounds, and find purpose in the unexpected.

1563310.title: Emmanuel
1563310.overview: The film tells the story of a key figure associated with the Brazilian medium Chico Xavier: the spirit Emmanuel, also known as his mentor.

1566702.title: Carnal
1566702.overview: A lonely misogynist experiences strange occurrences after purchasing a peculiar product online.

1575534.title: The Observance
1575534.overview: After five years in a coma following a fatal car accident, Madison Neubauer wakes to find her home and family in the grip of 'The Observance', a religious cult who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets.
1575534.trailerName: The Observance - Official Trailer (2025) Ted Raimi, Kate Dailey, Bronsonn Taylor

1577326.title: Srinivasa Mangapuram
1577326.overview: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.
1577326.trailerName: Srinivasa Mangapuram Trailer | Jai Krishna Ghattamaneni | Rasha Thadani | Mohan Babu | Ajay Bhupathi

1584430.title: The Inmate
1584430.overview: About an inmate who fears the outside world.

1586030.title: MEN TOO
1586030.overview: A man struggles to stay strong after a painful divorce, moving through his days with a quiet loneliness that no one notices. This PSA explores how a single moment of genuine care can change everything for someone who feels forgotten.

1587630.title: Marge
1587630.overview: After learning she’s pregnant, Sadie reflects back on the night she learned her mother was a serial killer. But now becoming a mother herself, Sadie suddenly finds herself understanding Marge in a way she never has before.

1594606.title: The Hostage's Hero
1594606.overview: Ship hijackings in the Malacca Strait are on the rise and attracting global attention. Lieutenant Colonel Taufiq is reassigned to Indonesia to lead a maritime patrol aboard the KRI Karel Satsuitubun. While on their mission, they face the hijacking of the MT Pematang tanker by a group of pirates. Amidst the dangerous task, the soldiers are faced with a dilemma between national responsibility and family.

1595886.title: Lights! Camera!! Scream!!!
1595886.overview: Three friends went to Maine to make a horror film.  They disappeared. The footage survived.

1596270.title: When a Witness Recants
1596270.overview: In 1983, author Ta-Nehisi Coates learned that a 14-year-old boy was murdered in his Baltimore middle school. Upon revisiting the case, he uncovers the truth: Three innocent teenagers were wrongfully convicted and spent 36 years in prison — creating a lasting impact on the accused, the witnesses, and their community.

1598766.title: Crayon Shin-chan the Movie: Very Bizarre! My Yokai Vacation
1598766.overview: Shin-chan and his family visit his father's home town of Akita in order to view the Omagari Fireworks Festival. When a strange incident to causes the residents of “Yokai Land” to begin running wild throughout Akita and the rest of Japan, Shin-chan and company are lured to “Yokai Land” for an unusual adventure.

1600174.title: The Bad Room
1600174.overview: A young couple's hopes of buying their dream home are put to the test when they learn the house they're inspecting is haunted. Well, not the whole house. It's just this one room - a very bad room.

1604270.title: Sense of Water
1604270.overview: In the chill of exile, an Iranian writer confronts a foreign language – a language in which he must rediscover love, anger, joy and sorrow in order to write again. His quest to reclaim the power of writing becomes an inner journey between memory and forgetting, between a lost language and a new one, where human, emotion and meaning must be recreated anew.

1606958.title: Theertharoopa Thandeyavarige
1606958.overview: A popular travel vlogger, Prithvi, uncovers a dark secret about his own family. His search for the truth leads him to his estranged father, setting him on a journey of self-discovery.  Does Prithvi Find Closure? Does Destination Meet Destiny?

1615918.title: Red Light Teachers
1615918.overview: A desperate immigrant forced into the world of underground strip clubs crosses paths with a disillusioned drama teacher, both rediscover the meaning of dignity, art, and second chances.
1615918.trailerName: Red Light Teachers - Immigrant City Tour Trailer

1616878.title: Doggerland
1616878.overview: Instead of finding a “proper” job, Alf, pushing 40, lives with his mum and drifts though Norrköping’s cultural scene. Chats & faces, routines & intuitions, local politics & everyday life – the intimate and the social, in black-and-white analogue images.

1617774.title: Sapiens
1617774.overview: Na Do-han, a man with Dissociative Identity Disorder, shares his body with four different identities. One dawn, he wakes up in a motel with blood-soaked hands and the word 'Run!' scrawled on a mirror. Soon linked to the disappearance of a wealthy corporate heir, Do-han becomes the prime suspect. Concurrently pursued by corporate lawyer Seo Hee-jae, he must interrogate his own identities, each concealing a secret.

1625582.title: The Kerala Story 2
1625582.overview: Three young Indian women across different states choose love over tradition, only to become trapped. Their parallel lives show how romance and rebellion transform into control and silence, turning love into a weapon that destroys freedom.
1625582.trailerName: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond| Official Trailer| Vipul Amrutlal Shah| Kamakhya Singh| Aashin A Shah

1627566.title: Bikini Nurses
1627566.overview: With the sheriff set to padlock their clinic at dawn, and a wealthy buyer on the prowl, three Bikini Nurses mount one last move: to impress their wealthiest patron with a show so that he'll buy the clinic and save the day.

1629038.title: Mallory's Ghost
1629038.overview: Mallory, tormented by a fear of being insignificant, accompanies her playwright boyfriend Sam to a retreat on the coast of Maine. She learns that he once took his glamorous ex-girlfriend there. She is overcome by an obsessive curiosity.

1632174.title: For Better And For Worse
1632174.overview: A group of friends, and the power of memory.

1633582.title: Negative Space
1633582.overview: Three detectives on the verge of solving the case of the serial killer.

1634414.title: Tropical Paradise
1634414.overview: A paradise fractured by violence. Revisiting a 1994 terrorist attack in Panama, TROPICAL PARADISE blends investigation and personal reflection to explore trauma, silence, and the lingering imprint of a tragedy that refuses to fade.

1641966.title: Untold: The Shooting at Hawthorne Hill
1641966.overview: A retired Olympic equestrian takes on a new dressage student at his idyllic farm in New Jersey. Over time, tensions mount between the two, leading to 911 calls, cryptic social media posts, and accusations of spying. The feud culminates in a shocking act of violence and a trial that rocked the prestigious and sophisticated world of dressage.

1649134.title: Mary the Widow
1649134.overview: An aging widow begrudgingly goes to a speed-dating event at her daughter’s request. Among a string of dud dates, one gentle stranger lingers in her mind. Mary the Widow is a tender look at love, memory, and the echoes of what we’ve lost.
1649134.trailerName: Mary the Widow - 2026 Trailer (starring Stephen Tobolowsky)

1658606.title: In Good Repair
1658606.overview: Following the passing of his wife, a devout church warden comes to question his lifelong devotion to the cause.

1660526.title: Please
1660526.overview: A dark comedy about humankind’s desire to love and to be loved. Centred around neediness, intimacy and romance.  Told through a series of loosely connected, tender and absurd scenes, the film follows people who are searching for closeness and acceptance. In a world that preaches self-control, the film explores the sides we try to hide, such as feeling needy and pathetic.  The stories overlap and reappear, gradually forming a portrait of collective longing.

1661294.title: Run Koala Run
1661294.overview: When an unseen animator begins rewriting his hand-drawn world, a lovable cartoon koala must outrun a reality that is literally changing around him in a frantic chase through the collision of art and algorithm.

1662958.title: Louis C.K.: Ridiculous
1662958.overview: From a bee getting shot in New York City to paying strangers to take his aging father, Louis C.K. unleashes the ridiculous thoughts in his mind.

1665710.title: Rent Free
1665710.overview: He thought he found a place to stay rent free… but nothing in life is free.  Marcus, a smooth-talking hustler, moves in with Shay, a quiet therapist hiding a dark past. But when his plan to con her is exposed, he quickly realizes he’s not in control. Trapped inside her apartment, Marcus is forced into a twisted game where every move comes with consequences and escape may cost him everything.

1672750.title: My Playground
1672750.overview: Trapped in Dubai where riding is “not allowed,” a young BMX rider hits the road on a worldwide adventure to find  epic spots, a real community — and himself.

1672942.title: In Dreams When You Can't Sleep at Night
1672942.overview: 15 years ago, Ariel completed my military service in the Israeli army's spokesperson unit. Today, based on real texts I found during my time there, I open up a dialogue with a young Israeli sniper.

1675182.title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記
1675182.overview: A terminally ill woman chooses to have a child and spends her final days embracing motherhood with courage and love.
1675182.original_title: ママがもうこの世界にいなくても　私の命の日記

1676398.title: Harvest
1676398.overview: Sondheimer, Louisiana. Population 200. Tucked in the northeast corner of the state, this rural enclave is home to the four Nelson Brothers—young, ambitious, fourth-generation commodity farmers who dream of becoming the biggest farmers in the United States.

1676846.title: Less Unhappy
1676846.overview: A gay man and a lesbian who are kicked out of the queer community for their toxicity and decide to try living as a straight couple, on the theory that straight people are dumb and therefore less miserable than smarter gay people.

1677102.title: Hamilton House
1677102.overview: A home of struggling actors will stop at nothing to create a haunted house to catch the eye of their new neighbor, a legendary horror filmmaker.

1677550.title: KillTonyMania
1677550.overview: Kill Tony tag teams with WrestleMania 42, as Tony Hinchcliffe, WWE icons and comedy heavyweights put upstart stand-ups to the test in Las Vegas.

1685870.title: The Way Through
1685870.overview: Italy, 2035. Mansfield, Stendhal and Buzzati are friends and partisans fighting against the regime. Engaged in relays of coded messages hidden in ciphered books, they are forced into a race against time: the fascists are about to take the town of Ovada.

1686190.title: The Way You See Me
1686190.overview: An intimate story about the construction of identity and the consequences of defying gender norms within Mexico's conservative upper-middle-class society.

1688878.title: Goodnight Lamby
1688878.overview: Three-year-old Zia searches for her missing stuffed Lamby through her father’s surreal sculpture-a vast world of oceans, caves, and outer space. Her quest becomes a journey of courage, wonder, and self-discovery.

1689006.title: Because of you Ka Kui
1689006.overview: A documentary feature celebrating the music, life, and artistic pursuit of Canto rock music legend Wong Ka Kui, whose voice and vision defined the sound of Beyond- the most influential Canto rock band of all time. Featuring rare concert footage, never-before-seen archives of Ka Kui's early years, and unreleased work, this documentary offers an intimate portrait of Wong Ka Kui- not through nostalgia, not as a distant legend, but as he truly was. At its heart is the precious legacy of his character and convictions—one that continues to transcend generations, his music still lifting spirits and inspiring hope today.
1689006.trailerName: 【Official Promo】 真的相識過 Because of You Ka Kui (2025)

1689198.title: The Mystery of Richard Simmons: A Diane Sawyer Special
1689198.overview: The beloved fitness personality's remarkable rise to fame; examining the cultural impact that made him a household name.

1689518.title: Christiane Taubira : une loi pour mémoire

1691182.title: Notun Premer Gaan
1691182.overview: Ritwik, struggling with corporate pressure and personal grief, travels to a place cherished by his late mother. He meets Ira, a spirited traveler navigating a restrictive, complicated relationship.
1691182.trailerName: Notun Premer Gaan | Official Trailer | Ayush D | Annmary T | Arna M | Fridaay

1692526.title: Train 39
1692526.overview: Train 39 follows a boy named Rowan as he sets out to buy groceries for his grandmother's 73rd birthday. After missing his train, he's left waiting on the platform, until a strange man directs him to board "Train 39," a train that seemingly appears out of nowhere behind him. Once aboard, Rowan loses consciousness and awakens in a pastel pink house within a dreamlike world where everything feels eerily perfect.

1692782.title: Video Hearts
1692782.overview: A mysterious VHS dating tape from the 1980s becomes the centerpiece of a chilling found-footage nightmare in Video Hearts, a horror short from filmmaker Ken Cohen. What begins as an awkward relic of lonely-hearts video culture slowly reveals something far more sinister hidden beneath the tape’s nostalgic surface, blending analog horror aesthetics with eerie psychological dread.

1693550.title: Pause
1693550.overview: While helping her grandmother with paperwork, a withdrawn young woman spends the day waiting among strangers in a municipal office, where passing encounters quietly begin to unsettle her isolation.

1693614.title: Космическая Машка
1693614.overview: Masha spent her entire 11 years of life with her cosmonaut father at the spaceport. She knows how to fly a plane, a boat, and take responsibility for herself, but she doesn't know how her peers live. To make friends and get used to life on Earth, she goes to a regular school in St. Petersburg, where her incredible adventures begin.

1694254.title: Caravelle 114
1694254.overview: At the height of Brazil’s military dictatorship, a flight would change the fate of everyone on board. Among the passengers were a mother, her two young children, and militants from VAR-Palmares with a daring plan: to divert Flight 114 to Cuba.  Caravelle 114 reconstructs, in fiction, the events behind the hijacking that defied the Brazilian dictatorship.

1694958.title: Dua Lipa: Live From Mexico
1694958.overview: Live from Mexico, a brand new concert film capturing the high-octane finale of the global Radical Optimism Tour at Mexico City's Estadio GNP Seguros
1694958.trailerName: DUA LIPA - RADICAL OPTIMISM TOUR AD

1701166.title: Bones
1701166.overview: The story of Sara Baartman’s final repatriation to South Africa in 2002, which was catalysed by a 1998 poem, “I’ve Come To Take You Home” by writer and activist Diana Ferrus.

1701678.title: You Can't Fly
1701678.overview: Follows Matt Lewis, aka Silverback Tarzan, as he comes to terms with being grounded following a near fatal hang-gliding accident. For someone with as much energy and “seize the day” drive as Tarzan, this isn’t easy, but, with the support of his loving partner Tara, Tarzan’s almost aggressive positivity wins through.

1703406.title: Train of Thought
1703406.overview: A new work from emerging filmmaker and prolific train-goer Katie Edwards.

1704110.title: M.E.N.A.G.E.R.I.E : A Presentable Liberty
1704110.overview: A test subject is picked to find the location of a missing prisoner. After old memories resurface, the subject finds himself up against something not of this world....  (Based on the Menagerie universe by Robert "Wertpol" Brock)

1705390.title: Project Baby
1705390.overview: The story follows Sandy, a 30-something advertising executive who, fearing her biological clock is ticking, launches "Project Baby"—a step-by-step mission to conceive a child on her own terms with a no-strings-attached donor. She selects Migo, a sensitive artist, but quickly realizes that meticulous plans can't account for human emotion.
1705390.trailerName: PROJECT BABY Official Trailer | Sue Ramirez and Rico Blanco | IN CINEMAS JUNE 10!

1707246.title: The LPC Files - Episode 1
1707246.overview: A short film following the first installment in the LPC files film franchise. Chris Evans got her pregnant?

1709678.title: Missing Pieces
1709678.overview: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

1711150.title: Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Runway Show
1711150.overview: The 2026 Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Runway Show brought models, athletes, influencers and celebrities to the catwalk. From pop star Lizzo to social media sensation Alix Earle, the show featured a diverse lineup of familiar faces showing off the latest swimwear trends. See all the runway looks in the gallery below.

1711406.title: As the Spring Arrives, Water Recalls the Nomads
1711406.overview: A heterogeneous group of shepherds travels through the Çukurova valley in Turkey, following in the footsteps of their nomadic ancestors. Between archives and imaginary correspondence, the film becomes an echo of the memory and disappearance of pastoral ecosystems.

1711918.title: Adore Him
1711918.overview: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

1714670.title: Heer Sara
1714670.overview: Two women embark on a rebellious motorcycle odyssey to Pondicherry - one seeking her lost mother, the other racing to uncover the truth behind a wedding. Laughter, chaos and sisterhood spark freedom, self-worth and eco-conscious living.
1714670.trailerName: Heer Sara Official Trailer | Patralekhaa & Maanvi Gagroo | Kartik Chaudhry | In Cinemas 12th June

1714798.title: Our House
1714798.overview: Charls Carroll stars as a Revolutionary War soldier washed ashore from the past and resurrected.

1714990.title: The Dream Machine
1714990.overview: Victor Neff moves into a new apartment and discovers a strange machine in the basement. Made of scrap metal, wires, and old television sets, it allows him to enter other people's dreams. But dreams are not empty, they are crowded with secrets, fears, and the dreamers themselves. - Based on the critically acclaimed point-and-click adventure game by Cockroach Inc.
1714990.trailerName: THE DREAM MACHINE | Official Trailer | July 12

1715502.title: Plata: The Price of Risk
1715502.overview: Plata: The Price of Risk — a documentary about how former Tinkoff Bank executives built a new bank in Mexico from the ground up. Oleg Tinkov, along with managers, developers, and product people from Russia — people who could have stayed home and lived comfortably. Instead, they left and bet everything on an impossible idea. How it turned out — watch the film.

1716334.title: RECOIL
1716334.overview: THE MAFIA.  A LIST.  A HITMAN.  Edgar is a hitman for a Mafia in Lille. One night, his boss gives him a list of people to eliminate for the safety of the mafia.

1717678.title: Rusty Bearclaw and The Rucket List
1717678.overview: An LDS teenager receives his call to serve a mission for his church. Realizing he doesn't have long before he leaves for two years, he creates a "pre-mission bucket list" to complete alongside his two idiotic best friends.
1717678.trailerName: Rusty Bearclaw And The Rucket List - A Comedy Short Film by The Johnson Brothers

1718190.title: Under Control
1718190.overview: In a silent world ruled by routine and precision, a man's search for order reveals a deep inner disturbance that leads him to a sudden moment of collapse.

1718318.title: Langkah
1718318.overview: Laffet, a village boy who wants to move to the city, is in conflict with his father who strongly rejects his decision. Mamak tried to calm him down, but Laffet still left. In the city he works, but missing his family continues to haunt him. When he finally returned home, he found only an empty house and signs of loss that he could not prevent

1718894.title: PAINT SPLATTER!
1718894.overview: Sam Stanicky looks up to and wants to be like his grandfather. His father, Jackson, isn't so approving though.

1719150.title: Betty
1719150.overview: Betty, an acclaimed, but washed-up painter, is commissioned to create an art piece for a prestigious museum. In order to regain the creative brilliance of the suffering artist, she isolates herself in a secluded house with one ambition: to induce depression.

1720110.title: Odd Man Sleep
1720110.overview: In an old Brazilian legend, if someone happens to fall asleep in the woods, under a tree, the spirit of a boy appears and torments them until something truly bad happens.

1721262.title: INGRESS LABYRINTH
1721262.overview: Trapped in a glass lift, Miss Ariadne relives memories of a relationship from which she cannot escape.

1721390.title: Western Blot!
1721390.overview: Western Blot! is a drawn-on-film animated short inspired by an analytical technique used in molecular biology, called a western blot.

1722798.title: The Black Sheep
1722798.overview: When her troubled younger brother bursts into her home covered in blood and carrying a bag of stolen cash, a woman must decide whether to save him or finally let him answer for his actions.

1722990.title: Crimson High
1722990.overview: When a human girl transfers to a prestigious academy for monsters and humans, she falls for a brooding vampire student, only to discover their love is the key to unlocking a dormant supernatural war.

1723630.title: A Grey Day in June
1723630.overview: A family visit through the eyes of the young narrator Sonu transitions from the simple joys of childhood games to the solemn reality of his great-grandmother’s final moments.

1725038.title: Aussie at Heart
1725038.overview: Samara, a former lawyer now event planner, reunites with Nate, her ex‑coworker and rival, to plan a couple's anniversary in Queensland and begin to confront their past and fall for each other.

1725166.title: Nostalgia for a Future That Could Not Be
1725166.overview: In a world where people have forgotten how to love, Tetsu, driven by a strange longing for something lost, embarks on a journey to recover what seems to have vanished from her world. Guided by a witch, she sets out in search of three strange beings who, in one way or another, still know how to love. Through encounters that blur the boundaries between memory, fantasy, and perception, her journey will lead her toward emotions and memories she believed had been forgotten.

1725998.title: Lonely Island
1725998.overview: Three girls who have known each other for ages are about to shoot a film. Overwhelmed by the excitement and joy of creating together, they overlook the enormous risks looming ahead.On the fourth day of filming, problems crop up one after another, leaving the three at a loss. Zheng Yuan refuses to weaponize the expressions she holds dearest to her heart; Fang Chi’s tender heart may become a stumbling block on her path as an actress; meanwhile, Zhao Xin, a rookie producer, strives to safeguard their idealism amid this overwhelming chaos.When they return home exhausted, the three discover that their two kittens have vanished without a trace…

1728046.title: Imprevisible, inevitable: un trajecte del metro a la Dana de València

1728238.title: UNTIL NEXT TIME
1728238.overview: After his fiancée's death, an emotionally unstable man is approached by a mysterious man who offers him a second chance to bring back what was lost at a deadly cost.
1728238.trailerName: UNTIL NEXT TIME | OFFICIAL TRAILER HD

1728686.title: Sixteen Moments of My Life
1728686.overview: Ingrid Caven sings about 16 moments from her life in a unique concert at the Théâtre des Bouffes du Nord in Paris.

1729134.title: Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story
1729134.overview: Third installment of Hallmark's "Holliday Touchdown" franchise. plot TBA.
1729134.trailerName: NEW! Holiday Touchdown: A Bears Love Story | Coming to Hallmark Channel This Countdown to Christmas!

1730542.title: The Burning Giants
1730542.overview: A mysterious smoke covers western Thailand, triggering a strange infectious disease whose symptoms resemble burns inflicted by an invisible fire. A villager from the Karen ethnic group is arrested deep in the jungle and taken to a quarantine centre. There, he dreams of returning to his mountain homeland. His wife, who has sought refuge in Bangkok, shares the same longing. But their hope is threatened by forest rangers determined to burn down their village to make way for a national park. Beyond the veil of smoke, an abandoned theatre stands hidden in the jungle, haunted by ogre soldiers fleeing the King’s army in an ancient war reflecting the struggle of the villagers.

1731310.title: Queen Victoria Aar Goyenda Kanaichawron
1731310.overview: A detective thriller based on Rajarshi Das Bhowmik's story Kalapaanir Disha.

1731502.title: Vivaah
1731502.overview: Vivaah revolves around four married couples as they navigate the chaotic challenges of modern relationships. From unexpected restrictions and arranged marriages to a wife's romantic longings amid a workaholic husband's neglect, the narrative follows four women fighting unique emotional battles in search of fulfilment and understanding.
1731502.trailerName: Vivaah - Trailer | Dhyan Sreenivasan | Abhishek Sreekumar | Dhruvan | Sruthi Jayan | Nayana Elza

1731694.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
1731694.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

1731950.title: Just Three Words
1731950.overview: Two brothers must prepare for the Christmas season while mourning the mysterious disappearance of their sister.

1733486.title: My Daughter's Trapped in a Throuple
1733486.overview: When Lori learns her daughter, Mia, has entered a throuple, her concern turns to fear when one member of the relationship is found dead and Mia becomes the prime suspect.

1733806.title: Hollow Girls
1733806.overview: On the night of June 2, 2023, a shocking crime shattered a quiet community. Six teenage girls lured one of their classmates into a deadly trap. Fueled by jealousy and a twisted desire for revenge, they set into motion a plan that would end in kidnapping, torture, and murder.

1736494.title: Life of Jorge Luis Borges
1736494.overview: A biography of Jorge Luis Borges working from an exhaustive review of the papers he left, the books he read, the places he went to. And with this, an attempt to decipher a very peculiar life: someone who lived like a hidden, underground warrior, whose cause was literature, literature conceived as a kingdom and as a landscape. If Cold War spies fought from their desks or from an uninhabited house to defend their half of the world, Borges strove from a library to elevate and broaden the territories of his own tribe: the people for whom the most important part of the universe is books, plots and words. This film is devoted to that secret pilgrim (to borrow from Le Carré, the king of all spies).

1740270.title: Fissures
1740270.overview: After her daughter moves away, Dalva begins hearing strange noises in the house where she has always lived. As she becomes aware of the cracks in a daily life that is slowly falling apart, something seems to be trying to emerge.

1741294.title: Phytophonics
1741294.overview: Plant matter is used to create finely detailed indexical traces on photochemical film. The traces are not only visible but also audible. Eco-punk against the abyss created by late-capitalism.

1741678.title: The Freezer
1741678.overview: In the devastated lands of the Madre de Dios mining exploitation in the southeastern Peruvian Amazon, a girl manages to escape the mafia holding her hostage. After escaping, she begins her search for justice, which will lead her to share her case with the entire nation, attracting the attention of politicians, prosecutors, judges, and police officers.

1743022.title: banano, banano
1743022.overview: Death arrives in a small town in the south of Guatemala City, with the mission of taking three people with her: a boy lost in a hill, a young woman adrift, and an old writer who always dreamed of being a filmmaker.  An essay that presents three short stories about Death and how living in this world makes her more human.

1743918.title: The Seedling
1743918.overview: Stress, stress, stress When you still trust in tales of storks there's not much there to be proud of. Something in the space below my stomach is growing roots — is it what I think it is, or just stress? Kama is creating a huge tree, her period is late, and her best friend wants to become an apron wife. The premiere of the play is in a week.

1744046.title: Bleeding Hearts
1744046.overview: A music-driven love story about real-life couple Zella Day and Jesse Woods, the musicians behind Chaparelle. Following their first year together, they chase a shared dream while facing pressures that could spark a breakup—or a breakthrough

1744302.title: Now, I See
1744302.overview: When a mysterious bicycle accident restores the sight of Simon, a 21-year-old who has been blind his entire life, his miracle comes with an unsettling catch. A cryptic message leads him to a door only he can see, where a secret organization offers him permanent vision at an unimaginable cost: his eyes will become live-streaming cameras, sacrificing his privacy in the name of a "safer world." Forced to choose between the gift of sight and his freedom, Simon must decide what he is truly willing to see.

1745518.title: Her Ciro
1745518.overview: A radio tower operator calls his wife in wartime.

1746094.title: Paul Heaton: Live at Bramall Lane
1746094.overview: Paul Heaton returns to Sheffield for a landmark homecoming performance at Bramall Lane, delivering a career-spanning set packed with legendary hits and fan favourites.
1746094.original_title: Paul Heaton: Live at Bramall Lane

1746734.title: Split-Vision
1746734.overview: The next film created by Krister Kahl.

1746798.title: Pleasant: First Look
1746798.overview: A stranded man in a hot dog costume continues his strange night in a open-late store. A proof of concept for the upcoming indie feature "Pleasant".

1747054.title: La Selva
1747054.overview: Maria, an immigrant mother, and her two daughters try to rebuild their lives in California, avoiding any mention of who's missing. When a stray black dog follows them home and refuses to leave, the silence begins to crack.

1747310.title: Ghosthing
1747310.overview: A stoic mortician endowed with the ability to perceive the deceased finds his quiet existence upended when the dramatic spirit of a high-profile influencer refuses to depart, forcing him into an unauthorized investigation to prove her sudden demise was the result of homicide.

1749166.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
1749166.overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

1749614.title: More Lovely
1749614.overview: A young woman journals about love characterized by three couples.

1751342.title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
1751342.overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera is a romantic musical story about a dream boy who always wishes to become a film hero. One day, while walking with his sister near Gokarna Shaheed Smarak Park in Kathmandu, he sees a film song being shot. Excited by the cameras, lights, music, and dancers, he asks his sister to go closer. Among the dancers, he notices a beautiful girl whose graceful dance immediately captures his heart. He begins to imagine himself as the hero of the song, dancing and romancing with her. In his dream, they share joyful and romantic moments filled with love, laughter, and chemistry. He expresses his feelings and even proposes marriage, dreaming of spending their lives together. At the end of the song, the girl whispers in his ear, “Let’s go together.” Suddenly, the director says, “Okay, cut!” and the dream boy returns to reality. His sister takes him home, leaving him with a beautiful dream of love and his wish to become a film hero.
1751342.original_title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera

1751598.title: Amarte
1751598.overview: He lives in his own universe. She is a famous soap opera star who needs to disappear from hers. When they meet by accident, what seems like a bad idea becomes a getaway as absurd as it is irresistible. As they flee from the press, between increasingly out of place situations, delirious moments and a connection that no one saw coming, both discover that escaping from reality can be much more fun... and dangerously irresistible for the heart. But when the real world reaches them again, they will have to decide if that encounter was just a perfect fantasy or if it is worth the risk of experiencing something real.

1753198.title: Corsu Mezu Mezu - Un soir au Vélodrome avec Patrick Fiori
1753198.original_title: Corsu Mezu Mezu - Un soir au Vélodrome avec Patrick Fiori

1753262.title: Counselle
1753262.overview: Thoughts of a Counselle stemming from Counseling producing a stream-of-consciousness.

1753582.title: The Ballad of Being a Better Mother
1753582.overview: Every morning, a middle-aged mother prepares breakfast for her family, as part of their daily routine that had never been fulfilled before. Life seems to carry on as normal, but something feels strange beneath the surface of this routine. When the village authorities arrive with a message, the truth that has long been hidden slowly begins to unfold.

1756590.title: How to Fast Train Your Furious Dragon
1756590.overview: The dream chasers race nitro-injected street cars and join forces with dragon rider Hiccup in the wildest cross-over ever dreamed up as 'DREAMZzz', 'The Fast and the Furious' and 'How to train your Dragon' collide head on. But the Nightmare King is always scheming and plans to corrupt the friendly dragons of Berk, and our heroes soon find themselves in a desperate race to save the Dream World.

1756974.title: Go Get It
1756974.overview: When a bizarre glitch throws the orders of a popular five-minute delivery app into chaos, a delivery rider finds himself caught in a chain reaction of increasingly dangerous mix-ups.

1757102.title: Holika: A Portrait of Fire
1757102.overview: The survivor of a communal massacre reflects on India's history of sectarianism amidst the light and joy of Holi.

1763502.title: Ulysses, New York
1763502.overview: New York independent filmmaker and provocateur Caveh Zahedi is known for putting his entire life on camera in pursuit of truth. In 2022, he decided to stage a production of James Joyce's Ulysses with barely any money and just a month to write, cast and rehearse. Ulysses, New York documents the chaos in Zahedi's distinctive, intensely confessional style, self-reflexive to the point of collapse. We present a work-in-progress version of the first chapter of a planned 24-hour epic.

1764206.title: HOME
1764206.overview: A hesitant exploration of a trans, non-binary person’s relationship with their body. A film-poem that draws a parallel between the body and a space: a home that requires care in order to function.

1767022.title: Building Bodies
1767022.overview: Sounds, sights, touch and memory come together in this sensory and emotional reflection on experiences living in and passing through the City Centre of Glasgow. This experimental documentary uses real testimonies, voiceover, footage and sound from the City Centre to convey an experience shared by residents and the built environment itself.

1768430.title: Nosebleed
1768430.overview: After trying an experimental new nasal spray to combat his hayfever, a man experiences a nosebleed with disturbing side effects.

1768622.title: 睡觉第一名
1768622.overview: "Sleeping Champion" (睡觉第一名) is a 12-minute brand short film released in August 2026. It was directed by Shao Yihui (邵艺辉) in collaboration with the sleep-wellness brand Atour Planet (亚朵星球).

1769454.title: never mind, everything's okay.
1769454.overview: On Christmas Eve, three estranged siblings gather to sell their deceased father's house, but a reading of his will unearths decades of buried resentment between them.

1770862.title: The Artists
1770862.overview: In a cold warehouse, two criminals debate their careers future over the rise of AI.
